nodes.label: Handyman Skill (agent work harness)
nodes.rationale: Core idea: the chat coordinates but the disk is the source of truth; every session has state, backlog, closure criteria and executable verification. Formerly named Foreman.

nodes.label: Local vs Global Install Modes
nodes.rationale: local keeps docs versioned next to code under .handyman/; global moves operational state to $HOME/HANDYMAN/<project> to keep the repo clean.

nodes.label: Anti Telefono Descompuesto Pattern
nodes.rationale: Long agent reports are written to backlog/ files and the chat only returns references, avoiding degradation of information between agents.

nodes.label: Obsidian Vault Integration
nodes.rationale: HARNESS_WORKSPACE opens directly as an Obsidian vault (frontmatter, #handyman/... tags, index.md MOC) without duplicating files.
